pros: Six-and-a-half-hour marathon cut-off and four hours for the half
Course runs through the Yen Tu heritage site, past its pagodas and Yen Trung lake
Marathon almost entirely on asphalt and fully lit for the early start
Finisher jacket for marathoners, finisher T-shirt for the half
cons: No route map, elevation profile, aid-station list or start times found for 2025
Forest roads with climbs; the 2024 course was described as gradually steepening
No finishing times published outside social media
No refund if the race is called off in the last 13 days
name: Yen Tu Heritage Marathon 2026
short_description: Yen Tu Heritage Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 29 November 2026 at Yen Tu in Quang Ninh, with a kids' race, 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: Yen Tu Heritage Marathon 2026 is a road race at the Yen Tu heritage area in Quang Ninh, organised by Great Race Solution. The event spans 28-29 November 2026, and the race itself is on Sunday 29 November. Categories are a kids' race, 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km, with entry fees rising through six price tiers.

faqs.question: How much does Yen Tu Heritage Marathon 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: Fees rise through six tiers between March and 21 November. The 42 km runs from 699,000 VND in the first tier to 1,539,000 VND in the last, and the 21 km from 579,000 to 1,279,000 VND. Groups of 15 or more receive an 8 percent discount on entries.

faqs.question: What are the age limits at Yen Tu Heritage Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The kids' race is for ages five to 11, the 5 km from eight, the 10 km from 14, the 21 km from 16 and the 42 km from 18, all counted in the competition year. Distance changes cost 100,000 VND each, and personal-detail changes cost 150,000 VND after 1 September.
